searchText: https://discord.com/channels/595666850260713488/874767108809031740/1464293608680067104 reposting a relevant api discussion from epbs channel for gloas <@&1337018366795186237> ^^ would like an opinion on this discussion in epbs on stateful beacon apis cc <@737740104281489531> I am kinda curious how useful the stateless part currently is, does anyone have data/metrics that tracks this, ie. how often does the bn that produced the block not publish it because it went offline in-between I guess the other part of this is that the vc can publish to multiple bns help in publishing, we could still pass around the blobs in addition to `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` for that also outside of https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/552#discussion_r2642624992 have other endpoints been updated for gloas yet? 😅 or anyone raise a pr? like for /eth/v2/debug/beacon/states/{state_id} that PR covers a pretty wide range of endpoints already, but yeah state needs to be updated but CL spec was moving a lot, but would like to merge that PR soon and we can update other parts too now maybe we can do it after discussing on monday what we want to do about the statefulness? are there other concerns? I didn't see anything that stood out yet statefulness was biggest concern from my side but even on that part we can iterate on master branch, for devnet-0 the current apis will work as is agreed https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/pull/552/files#r2722805266 seems like we need to do another pass i just saw one of the fields missing compared the master branch on consensus specs question https://github.com/ethereum/beacon-APIs/blob/master/apis/beacon/blocks/root.yaml, is it acceptable to return an error if querying by slot and the block is not canonical? or do we want to return a root even if it's not canonical

excerpts.content:
I am kinda curious how useful the stateless part currently is, does anyone have data/metrics that tracks this, ie. how often does the bn that produced the block not publish it because it went offline in-between

I guess the other part of this is that the vc can publish to multiple bns help in publishing, we could still pass around the blobs in addition to `SignedExecutionPayloadEnvelope` for that
